request.system: You are analyzing historical measurements for avGFP fluorescence. Larger log brightness is better. Only observations have measured fluorescence. Menu values and tool scores are fitted predictions. Use the observed evidence, state a testable short hypothesis, and specify edits that match displayed candidate identities on the pinned GFP reference. All eligible candidates are from a fixed menu. Do not estimate or cite measurements for candidates. Keep all text fields concise and evidence-specific.

decision.hypothesis: Conservative or surface edits (K/R, N/D, T43A, K26E) keep brightness near the high observed level of O1-O3, while edits at buried or core positions (P, S, I/F to polar) lower it.
decision.critic: Estimates differ by under 0.04 and uncertainties (0.08 to 0.14) exceed that gap, so the ranking is weak. Evidence O1, O3 and O7 are only two-edit or three-edit combinations.
decision.selection_rationale: C32 has the highest estimate (3.609) with the lowest uncertainty (0.084). C01 (3.588) shares N144D with observed O3. C31, C16 and C35 follow at about 3.57. C11 is omitted because its estimate is lowest (3.558).
